verdict.rationale: gstack is an agent skill and workflow pack, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only built-in automatic behaviors: end-of-session learning logs, per-host note injection, an auto-upgrade env flag, and voice-phrase aliases that invoke skills. None of these is a user-definable rule that fires an action when an event occurs, so they are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
